title: Kuya Jun, ang Fixer
setup: May problema ang pamilya mo — hindi maayos ang papeles sa munisipyo. Lumapit si Kuya Jun, nakangiti. 'Ako na bahala. Kilala ko ang lahat doon.'
setup_en: Your family has a problem — the papers at the municipal hall aren't in order. Kuya Jun approaches, smiling. 'I'll take care of it. I know everyone there.'

success.text: Naayos mo ang papeles nang sarili mo.
success.text_en: You fix the papers on your own.

fail.text: Naiwan ang papeles. Bumaba ang pera, pero natuto ka.
fail.text_en: The papers are delayed. Money drops, but you learn.

choices.label: Isama ko si Aling Cora, baka alam niya.
choices.label_en: I'll bring Aling Cora, she might know.

fail.text: Naiwan, pero natulungan ka ni Aling Cora.
fail.text_en: Still delayed, but Aling Cora helps you understand.

choices.label: Hayaan ko na lang si Nanay.

callback: Utang +2 -> Singil. Kuya Jun -> recurring fixer (Ch3).
